meta.description: Asset manifest for every embedded resource extracted from Rufus 4.15.2396 (86 payloads).
meta.extraction: PE .rsrc leaf (type/name/language) dump verified with REA inspect_pe_resources, 86 resources / 178 entries, coverage complete
meta.unique_key: (type, id): Windows resource names repeat the same numeric id across different resource types (ICON 1, VERSION 1 and MANIFEST 1 all have id "1"), so consumers must key on the (type, id) pair; `file` is unique in this manifest and can be used as the sole key.
meta.ordering: entries are grouped by resource type in this documented order: ICON (RT_ICON), GRPICON (RT_GROUP_ICON), DIALOG (RT_DIALOG), VERSION (RT_VERSION), MANIFEST (RT_MANIFEST), RCDATA (RT_RCDATA); within each group ascending numeric id, ties broken by file name (no ties today). Regenerate in exactly this order so a future regeneration diffs cleanly against this file.
meta.caveat: Resource names for FreeDOS utilities (300-326) and certificate bundles (701-704) are content-based inferences from static analysis; re-verify in S20/S23.
